$comment: First cut of the newswitch driver manifest — the versioned contract the optikit bindings wizard consumes (OPTIKIT-INTEGRATION.md §4, WP-192 (e) in optikit-v2 part2s). Served live as GET /system/drivers by a running newswitch; this file is the vendored snapshot for offline wizard runs, and the matching target while neither side is built. Deliberately naive: two drivers, just enough to make the matching real. Field types use JSON Schema draft 2020-12; '$comment' keys are annotations, not data.

schemas.$comment: Shapes shared by every driver. The newswitch loader owns these (CONFIG-MODEL.md §5.2 AxisBinding/HomingSpec/SlotBinding); a driver never redefines them. Units live in field names, always.

axis.$comment: One motor axis. Exactly one of steps_per_um (linear) / steps_per_deg (rotary). min/max are checked against the driven DOF's range at LINK time (E_RANGE_MISMATCH); steps-per-unit against its resolution (W_RESOLUTION_COARSE).

node.$comment: CANopen node id; null/absent for REST-addressed axes

uc2.stage.title: UC2 motorized stage
uc2.stage.description: Multi-axis stepper stage over the UC2 bus (CANopen multi-node or REST/serial master).

axes.$comment: What the wizard offers on the 'drives' matching step: each declared axis binds to EXACTLY ONE design DOF whose kind matches, and only DOFs with actuation: firmware are offered (WP-192 (c)). Axis config validates against schemas/axis.

params.$comment: Driver-level parameters (per-axis facts live in axes, transport facts on the transport entry).

settle_ms.$comment: wait after motion-done before reporting in-position

uc2.rest.camera.title: UC2 USB3 camera
uc2.rest.camera.description: USB3 industrial camera (e.g. HIK, Thorlabs CS165MU) via the vendor SDK. Streams into the FrameBroadcaster.
uc2.rest.camera.$comment: mounts_categories: the wizard offers this driver only for design components of these categories.
uc2.rest.camera.$comment.reports: At connect the driver reads sensor width/height/pixel pitch from the SDK and the loader compares them with the mounted design record — disagreement is E_SENSOR_MISMATCH per field (OPTIKIT-INTEGRATION.md §3). This is why the binding carries NO pixel_size_um: the record owns it (R1).

serial.$comment: which physical camera; the one fact only the bench knows

exposure_ms_limits.$comment: clamp for profile-set exposures; the profile owns the VALUE (L3), the driver owns the LIMIT

examples.$comment: One valid bindings.yml devices entry per driver, as YAML-equivalent JSON — what step 4 of the wizard emits.
